999008199.text:
はぁ～～～
ひーまーだーなー
姉様、またしりとりする……？

localizations.en: Would you like to play a word game again...?

999008199.text:
やだ、ベップ強いもん！
動物鳴き声クイズもネタが尽きたし

localizations.en: No way, you're too good at it! And we've run out of animal sound questions too.

999008199.text:
……誰か来ます。
この足音は……コウセン！
やあ皆様がた、ご機嫌いかがかな？

localizations.en: Well hello there, everyone. How are you all faring?

999008199.text:
見ての通り、最悪さ。
無粋な誰かさんが牢に放り込んでくれたからね

localizations.en: Terrible, as you can see. A certain tactless individual threw us in a dungeon.

999008199.text:
別の世界からやって来た異邦人の錬金術士……
ソフィーというのはあなたで間違いありませんかな？

localizations.en: An alchemist from another world... Sophie, are you not?

999008199.text: そうですけど……なんのご用ですか

localizations.en: That's right... what do you want?

999008199.text:
世界によって理は異なるというのに、別の世界でも
あれだけの力を出せる……素晴らしい才能です

localizations.en: Even though the laws of nature differ between worlds, you can still wield such power in this one... Truly magnificent talent.

999008199.text:
まるで別の世界のことを知っているような口ぶりね？
ケイウンでは常識、なのかしら？

localizations.en: You speak as if you know about other worlds. Is this common knowledge in Keiun?

999008199.text:
いえ、皆様と会うまで
異なる世界など考えたことも……

localizations.en: No, until we met all of you, I never even considered the existence of other worlds...

999008199.text:
ぜひ、そのお力を我々のために貸していただきたい。
強きケイウンを蘇らせるために……

localizations.en: Please, I would very much like you to lend us your power. To resurrect a mighty Keiun...

999008199.text:
これ、玉涎香……！
まずい、アタシたちもやられちゃう！

localizations.en: That's Jade Nectar...! This is bad—we're going to be affected too!

999008199.text:
みんな、身を低くして、口元に布を当てて
呼吸は浅く、少なくするの！

localizations.en: Everyone, get down low and cover your mouths with fabric! Keep your breathing shallow and minimal!

999008199.text: 息を殺すのは狩人の基本技能よ。これくらい余裕

localizations.en: Holding your breath is a basic hunting skill. This is nothing.

999008199.text: コウセン様……何をしておられるのですか？

localizations.en: Master Kosen... what are you doing?

999008199.text:
おやおや、誰かと思えば千歳殿。
お一人とは珍しいですな？

localizations.en: Well, well, if it isn't Chitose. How unusual to see you alone.

999008199.text:
一人ではありません。鏑矢様もじきに
いらっしゃいます。彼女たちから話を聞くために

localizations.en: I'm not alone. Lady Kaburaya will be here shortly to hear what they have to say.

999008199.text: ですので……ここはお引き取りください

ほう……鏑矢様のお気に入りの巫女様は
私に命令できる立場におりましたかな？

localizations.en: Oh my... is Lady Kaburaya's favorite shrine maiden now giving me orders?

999008199.text:
……ですが、ここは千歳殿の顔を立てておきましょう。
失礼いたします

localizations.en: ...But I shall honor your request, Chitose. This time. If you'll excuse me.

999008199.text: た、助かった……千歳さん、ありがとうございます

localizations.en: Th-that was close... Thank you so much, Chitose.

999008199.text:
いえ、どうも他に何か急用ができたのかと……
コウセン、やはりあの者が鏑矢様を……

localizations.en: It seemed like he suddenly had urgent business elsewhere... Kosen really is manipulating Lady Kaburaya...

999008199.text: （……おかしい）

（沿岸部に展開した式神の反応が一斉に消えた。
　奴らの仲間たちの仕業か？）

localizations.en: (The shikigami I deployed along the coast have all stopped responding at once. Could it be the work of their companions?)

999008199.text:
（いや、奴らにこれほどの力はなかったはず……
　ともかく、状況を確かめねば）

localizations.en: (No, they shouldn't have had that kind of power... In any case, I must investigate the situation.)

999008199.text: 到着早々、なかなか派手なお迎えだったね

localizations.en: That was quite the flashy welcome party right after we arrived.

999008199.text:
しかし相手がこんな紙っぺらじゃあ、
倒した甲斐がないってもんだ

localizations.en: But when the enemy's just flimsy paper cutouts like that, there's no satisfaction in beating them.

999008199.text: そう？　変な魔物だから僕は戦うの、楽しかったけどな

localizations.en: Really? They not the usually fare, so I thought fighting them was pretty fun.

999008199.text:
いずれにせよ、この島で良からぬことが
起こっているのは確かなようです

localizations.en: In any case, it's clear that something troubling is happening on this island.

999008199.text: まずは島内を見て回り、状況を把握しなくては！

localizations.en: First, we must survey the island and assess the situation!

999008199.text: だね、「管理」を正しく行うためにも

localizations.en: Right, we need to properly manage things after all.

999008199.text:
そういえば、さっきリーベから報告が来てたよ。
レスナたちがこっちに向かおうとしてるってさ

localizations.en: Oh, that reminds me—we got a report from Liebe earlier. Resna and the others are heading this way.

999008199.text: あらら。止めに行ったんじゃなかったっけ？

localizations.en: Huh? Wasn't she supposed to stop them?

999008199.text:
存外手を焼いたようでね。
あちらも引き下がるつもりはないみたいだ

localizations.en: Seems like they gave her more trouble than expected. And it looks like they have no intention of backing down.

999008199.text: いざとなれば私たちが迎え撃てば良いだけのこと

localizations.en: If it comes to that, we'll simply deal with them ourselves.

999008199.text:
そうだね。各戦力が入り乱れてきた。
なかなかに愉快な状況だよ

localizations.en: True. All the different forces at work are converging. This is turning into quite an entertaining situation.
